description: Most-viewed remote jobs on a board right now (social proof / trending roles).

board.description: Which job board to search. Defaults to the board this server is installed from. frontend = remotefrontendjobs.com, backend = remotebackendjobs.com, java = remotejavajobs.com.

name: top_viewed

country.description: ISO code the results were limited to, or null when not filtered by country.

geo.description: Where candidates must live, e.g. "US", "Europe". Null with worldwide=false means the posting does not say.

url.description: Canonical job page — always cite this.

title: List trending jobs
